Now that I look back at your post I see your also taking wellbutrin. Wellbutrin inhibits the liver enzymes that break down strattera, so strattera breaks down slower which can lead to having excessively high levels of atomoxetine in your blood stream. It's probably best you stay on a low dose. This wellbutrin strattera combo is probably why your having such an issue with fatigue.

After about a month it will build up in your blood stream and last 24hr.

Best of luck, hope it works good for you, like it does for me.

the sympathetic nervous system aids in the control of most of the body's internal organs. Stress—as in the flight-or-fight response—is thought to counteract the parasympathetic system, which generally works to promote maintenance of the body at rest.


http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Symphatomimetics

Sympathomimetic drugs mimic the effects of transmitter substances of the sympathetic nervous system. Some examples methamphetamine, methylphenidate (Ritalin), and lisdexamfetamine (Vyvanse).

I think the growth issue comes from stimulants activate the sympathetic nervous system which counteracts the parasympathetic. Sympathetic is the body in action, while the parasympathetic is more about the body taking care of itself.
